findings.reason: a node implementing §5 as written leaves the text-replace path unguarded while believing it is covered, and a done-when test written in state mode would pass regardless, so the gap survives into the built code.
findings.text: §5 states the widened `_require_heading_for_section_records` is run by `_write_state_locked` "on every plan write in both text and state mode", but text-mode plan writes (`edit_plan` mode='text' → `_edit_plan_prose` → `replace_plan_text`/`replace_plan_text_batch` → `_replace_plan_text`, reckon/mcp.py:3486,3883,3893) never enter `_write_state_locked` (reckon/_store.py:1211) and so never call that guard — the guard's only call site is reckon/_store.py:1381, inside `_write_state_locked` — so a text-mode write can leave a declaration without a heading or a heading without a declaration unrefused, contradicting §5's claim of full coverage

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/_plan_html.py`, `reckon/mcp_views.py`, `reckon/serve.py`'s `/plan/<project>/<slug>`, `_store.read_plan`, `read_state_and_text_file`, `derive_impl_from_sections`, `_require_heading_for_section_records`, `_require_new_section_contracts`, `reckon audit-doc`, `_without_section_declarations` and `keep_declarations=` all resolve as cited.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §3 names a negative control for each test that already holds (`keep_declarations=True` mutation) and states the first test fails on current code; §5 states both its tests fail on the current code, which checks neither.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §5 and §6 write their censuses into the node's evidence record, and no node names a session scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new surface names (`todos`, `c-close-<id>`, `section-without-todo`, `todo-without-section`) carry no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag, and no changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §5 claims text-mode plan writes are covered by the widened guard, but they bypass `_write_state_locked` entirely, so the mechanism does not run on the path §5 asserts.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §3 delivers the todo derivation and the predicate it feeds, and §5 delivers the coverage control (audit error + write refusal) as one "every section has a todo item" goal.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan declares no `depends-on`/`informs`/`gates` relationships to be wrong, and the cross-plan references it makes (the plan-review session in §2, the deferred merge wait in §8) are prose statements, not dangling node edges.
